attribution.title: Banks Mansion, Herengracht 519-525: former bank of 1923 on the Vijzelstraat corner
attribution.author: Map Recall
attribution.modifications: Original texture-free flat-colour geometry on the BAG footprint (CC0) with the 3DBAG LoD2.2 shell and mansard (CC BY 4.0): the rendered ground floor with engaged columns and small-paned windows, two wrought-iron balconies, architraved windows, the modillion cornice, stone dormers, the chamfered corner with its entrance, lanterns, BANKS letters and large central dormer. Measured from Gemeente Amsterdam panoramas (CC BY 4.0). No pixels or meshes imported.
